question: Jog falls, the highest waterfalls in India is also known as?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gersoppa Falls**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jog Falls** is the highest waterfall in India.
 
• It is also known as **Gersoppa Falls**.
 
• Jog Falls is located on the **Sharavathi river** in the state of Karnataka.
